_doc: One rule for what stops what (docs/ABILITIES.md 'Blockers and crossers', scripts/combat/blockers.gd, --blocker-check). Each crosser has a class; the class row says stop, pass or na (can't meet) per blocker kind. arch: the kit the check fires it from.

shot.what: every projectile (LMB weapons, kit shots, Boki shots)

chain.what: Kael's Short Leash (bites the wall it meets)

phase.what: Lace's Slip Stitch (through walls, objects and raised terrain; only the edge guard stops it)

trade.what: Motley's Trade (a high lob, then a swap)
